title: andropogon andongensis
intro: Andropogon andongensis, commonly known as East African lemongrass, is a type of grass belonging to the Poaceae family. This plant has been used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and acting as an antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of East African lemongrass include its antispasmodic, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its use in treating fever, colds, and respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of Andropogon andongensis include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
